title: Microsoft Purview: Azure PST Import to Exchange Online mailboxes
summary: The briefing agrees with the roadmap and Microsoft's supplied notice, and the Azure role-assignment path and command are documented. The summary should describe January 2027 as a preview target rather than a firm availability date.

claims.claim: Azure PST Import is a Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management capability.
claims.quote: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management- Azure PST Import

claims.claim: The planned migration method imports PST files from Azure Blob Storage directly into Exchange Online mailboxes.
claims.quote: Azure PST Import is a migration method that enables PST files stored in Azure Blob Storage to be imported directly into Exchange Online mailboxes.

claims.claim: Assigning an Azure role requires Microsoft.Authorization/roleAssignments/write permissions at the corresponding scope or higher.
claims.quote: To run the command, you must have a role that includes Microsoft.Authorization/roleAssignments/write permissions assigned to you at the corresponding scope or higher.

claims.claim: Microsoft says administrator access to PowerShell cmdlets and Azure role assignments controls this feature.

claims.claim: The documented Azure role-assignment procedure is a general control for granting blob access to applications, rather than Azure PST Import-specific guidance.
claims.quote: Azure Storage built-in and custom roles help you grant least-privilege access to users, groups, and applications.

claims.claim: Azure role assignment changes can take up to 10 minutes to take effect.
claims.quote: When you assign roles or remove role assignments, it can take up to 10 minutes for changes to take effect.

claims.claim: The existing Purview PST import turns on retention hold for imported mailboxes.
claims.quote: After you import PST files to a Microsoft 365 mailbox, the retention hold setting for the mailbox is turned on indefinitely.

claims.claim: Without retention hold, mailbox retention settings could delete old imported messages.
claims.quote: If messages you import to a mailbox are old, the retention settings configured for the mailbox might cause those messages to be permanently deleted (purged).

claims.where: Open questions: existing size guidance and limits
claims.claim: Existing Purview PST import guidance recommends PST files no larger than 20 GB.
claims.quote: Upload or copy PST files that are no larger than 20 GB. Large PST files can affect the performance of the import process.

claims.where: Open questions: existing size guidance and limits
claims.claim: Existing Purview PST import skips mailbox items larger than 150 MB.
claims.quote: If a PST file contains a mailbox item that's larger than 150 MB, the import process skips the item and doesn't import it.

claims.where: Open questions: existing size guidance and limits
claims.claim: Existing Purview PST import cannot import more than 100 GB into a user's archive in a single import.
claims.quote: As a result, you can't import more than 100 GB of data into a user's archive in a single import.

claims.claim: The notice refers to existing Exchange Online and Microsoft Purview audit logging for import administration and resulting mailbox changes.
claims.quote: Administrative actions related to PST import and the resulting mailbox changes are logged using existing Exchange Online and Microsoft Purview audit logging mechanisms.
